title: 20th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/20/1/2025).

Matter submitted under Rule 201 of the Majlis Standing Orders by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim, to bring to the government's attention the neglect by state institutions responsible for providing health assistance and social protection to persons with disabilities.
National Security Services Committee report on the Bill amending the Maldives Immigration Act (Law No. 1/2007).

State-Owned Enterprises Committee report on the President's request for Majlis consent to appoint the Chair of the Privatization and Corporatization Board under Article 9(a) and (b) of the Act on Privatization, Corporatization, Monitoring and Evaluation of State Businesses (Law No. 3/2013).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to debate an MP's motion on state neglect of persons with disabilities and take up committee reports on the Immigration Act amendment bill and the Privatization Board chair appointment.
